title: A relationship becomes an investment club
scenario: Someone you met online has talked with you daily for two months. They never pressured you for money, but now they offer to teach you a trading strategy and show screenshots of strong returns.

answers.A: Try a very small investment and only continue if you can withdraw it.
answers.B: Do not invest through a platform or wallet recommended by an online romantic interest; keep the relationship and money separate.
answers.C: Research the platform independently and discuss the idea with a trusted financial professional or friend before acting.

explanation: Long-con romance investment scams build trust first and may allow early withdrawals to increase confidence.
proTip: Time invested in a relationship is not due diligence on an investment.
